localities.name: Vernon Volcanics
localities.lede: Crystalline rhyolite and sparkling pyrite — evidence of intense geological activity. Each piece carries the raw energy of the Okanagan landscape.

localities.name: Similkameen Valley
localities.region: Princeton to the river bars · British Columbia
localities.lede: Agates and jaspers tumbled for millennia in mountain streams, hand-picked for banding and iron-stained hues. Quartz that still remembers both crystal and current.

localities.name: Unplaced
localities.lede: If we cannot point to the ground, we do not invent the stone's address. These pieces wait here without a false locality.
